summary: Mohawk (Account 2500322) and Dal-Tile (Account 2500325) have a Cigna Premium PHT plan with Capital Rx for retail and mail order non-specialty pharmacy (effective 1.1.25) and Vivio for specialty medications carved out from both medical and pharmacy benefits. Eighteen specialty drugs (including EPOETIN ALFA/PROCRIT J0885, ARANESP J0881, BETASERON J1830, PULMOZYME J7639, TOBI J7682, GLEEVEC S0088, HYCAMTIN ORAL J8705, FUZEON J1324, APOKYN J0364, KINERET J3490, SIMPONI J3490, ARCALYST J3490, SOMATULINE DEPOT J1930, EXTAVIA J1830, AFINITOR J8561, and CHORIONIC GONADOTROPIN/NOVAREL/PREGNYL J0725) are excluded from medical coverage and carved out to Vivio when administered in office visit settings. The account has imaging allowance maximums of $2,300 for MRIs and $2,000 for CT scans (after deductible is met, effective 01-01/2025), with Cigna paying 80% up to the allowed amount and employees responsible for any remaining costs. Customers should be steered to lowest cost providers (free-standing facilities vs hospital-based services) and can verify costs through Garner Health app (getgarner.com), Referral Coordinator (855-566-4295), Healthy Life Team (855-566-4295 option 4), or mycigna.com. The account is eligible for the My Personal Champion program, which provides single point-of-contact support for administrative needs including multiple denied authorizations, out-of-network claims, denied claims, repeat issues, outstanding claims, provider billing issues, and COB coordination. Medical programs include Healthy Pregnancies Healthy Babies, HSA through Fidelity (1.800.835.5087), FSA through TaxSaver (1.800.328.4337), and MDLive telehealth (effective 1.1.26, 888.726.3171).
